newsitem.title: UK: LME copper hold gains in evening session.
newsitem.headline: LME copper hold gains in evening session.

text.p: LME copper maintained its afternoon gains on Wednesday's evening session.
At 1800 GMT, three months copper was indicated at $2,368/69 per tonne against an afternoon kerb close of $2,370, a $10 gain from Tuesday.
Traders said copper was expected to stay within the current $60 technical range which has a ceiling around $2,380.
Aluminium stood at $1,568/61 against the kerb close of $1,661, the highest level in six weeks.
Other metals were little changed to slightly up.
